assumptions: THIS INCREMENT CHANGES NO DECISION AND NO CODE. It removes one spent blocker and rewrites two whose stated reason went false. It is the same defect class as commit 9aee8bb -- sentences true when written and false afterwards -- applied to a manifest.

AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS INCREMENT WAS WRONG THREE WAYS AND AN INDEPENDENT CHECK FOUND IT. It asserted 45 tables, 554 isolation cases and 116 service case ids. Those are the counts on agent/claude/WP-0A-DB-00-quadratic-strip, which carries the unmerged 070_research.sql; at f3d3102, which is what this branch declares as its base, they are 40, 481 and 100. It also quoted batch 070's header as present tree state when 070 is not on main. Measuring a claim about one tree against another is precisely the defect this increment exists to repair, and it was committed here before it was caught.

THE THIRD ERROR WAS WORSE THAN A COUNT. The earlier text read "a refusal observed today attributes to the absent grant rather than to a policy". That is FALSE and the repository asserts the opposite: identity-isolation.test.mjs carries a test named "the service denial is attributable to row level security and not to a forgotten grant", and grants to app_worker exist in 010_identity.sql, 020_business.sql and 060_ai_gateway.sql precisely so the denial is attributable to a policy. Measured directly: set_config('role','app_worker',true) switches current_role, and app_worker's rolbypassrls is false.

SO THE CONCLUSION ITSELF WAS TOO STRONG, NOT ONLY THE REASON. What RFC-2026-017 §7 asks for -- a service identity denied with an ERROR rather than an empty result -- exists at f3d3102 and runs: 58 blocks declare they cover §7 and 26 of them expect a denial. The blocker is still LEFT OPEN, because closing it would be this package judging its own §7 condition met; what is now recorded is the evidence and the question, for an independent reviewer to close or refuse.

amends_without_owning IS EMPTIED AND `recorded_on` IS REMOVED WITH IT. verify-branch-scope exits 74 on a declared pattern matching nothing in the diff -- replayed against this branch, the previous manifest's four paths are all dead. `recorded_on` named work-packages/WP-0A-A0-002.json as the register holding the amendment record; that register's ownership.amended_by has never carried an entry for this package, so the reference was dangling before this branch and is meaningless once `paths` is empty.

STATUS IS DELIBERATELY NOT MOVED: this package stays in_progress. An Author may move work only as far as in_review, and moving it would be a claim about completeness rather than the correction of false sentences.

security_privacy_cost_impact: None to the code. The privacy-relevant point is what the manifest now SAYS: it no longer implies that no tenant table exists, which a reader could take as meaning there is nothing yet to isolate. There are 45 tables and the isolation of the service path is still unproven, and those two facts are now in the same sentence.
known_limitations: NOTHING PREVENTS THE NEXT STALE SENTENCE. A blocker list is prose and no lint reads English. The rule that would catch this class ties a blocker naming a decision record to that record's status, and it is not written here.

THE REWRITTEN BLOCKERS STILL CITE COUNTS, AND A COUNT IN PROSE IS WHAT WENT WRONG HERE ONCE ALREADY. They now name the revision the counts were taken at (f3d3102), which is the difference between a fact and a claim -- but nothing checks that the revision named is the revision the reader is looking at.

WHETHER §7 IS DISCHARGED IS LEFT UNANSWERED ON PURPOSE, and that leaves a blocker open that may not deserve to be. The alternative was for this package to close its own condition, which is the shape no_self_approval exists to refuse.

THIS PACKAGE'S COUNTS HAVE BEEN WRONG TWICE AND RE-MEASURED FOUR TIMES, across bases f3d3102, ff12b8b and 2e18f75. The last two re-measurements found no change, and that was CHECKED with git diff over migrations, isolation-cases.mjs and run.mjs rather than inferred from the diff being small. A count in prose is only true against a named revision; a rebase renames the revision; and nothing in this repository notices when it does.
open_risks_or_blockers: Three blockers remain OPEN and are listed in the manifest. This increment closes none of them.

THE §7 QUESTION NEEDS AN INDEPENDENT READER. The assertion RFC-2026-017 §7 names exists and runs at f3d3102; whether 26 denial cases over 40 tables discharge it is a judgement this package must not make about itself.
rollback_or_forward_fix: ROLLBACK: revert this commit. The manifest returns to four blockers, one forbidding work that is on main and two giving reasons that stopped being true, and to four amendment paths this branch does not touch.
recommended_next_work_packages: An independent reading of whether RFC-2026-017 §7 is discharged. The evidence is in this package's first blocker; the judgement is not this package's.
The RFC that creates a worker identity that is not postgres. Until it exists, nothing outside a test helper can be app_worker and RFC-2026-019 §4/3's connection method stays undecided.
A rule tying a blocker that names a decision record to that record's status, if one can be written without reading prose.
reviewer_instructions: Re-measure the three counts at f3d3102 yourself rather than reading them. An earlier version of this increment carried counts from an unmerged branch, and that is the failure this file is correcting.
Check that no sentence claims a service refusal attributes to a missing grant. The repository asserts the opposite in a test named for it.
Decide the §7 question or refuse it explicitly. It is left open on purpose and it is the one thing here that needs someone other than this package.
Confirm nothing outside this package's two owned files changed.
